app_fee.value: Liberal Arts and Sciences graduate applicants pay a $50 non-refundable application fee, including the Philosophy and Theology PhDs.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers go through a request form reviewed against internal criteria the page does not list; no international-specific waiver is given.
fee_waiver.quote: Keep in mind that all waivers are subject to review and approval by Office of Graduate Studies admissions staff and internal waiver criteria.

gre_general.value: GRE rules are set program by program; the Philosophy PhD says the GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: Non-US citizens must submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo scores, but the page gives no TOEFL minimum.
toefl_min.quote: Official TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo scores (for applicants who are non-US citizens)

ielts_min.value: Non-US citizens must submit an IELTS score, but the page gives no IELTS minimum.
ielts_min.quote: Official TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo scores (for applicants who are non-US citizens)

english_waiver.value: Indian applicants are non-US citizens and must submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo scores; the page names no exemption for an English-medium degree.
english_waiver.quote: Official TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo scores (for applicants who are non-US citizens)

notes: Office of Graduate Studies rules for Liberal Arts and Sciences (its doctoral programs are Philosophy and Theology, both non-STEM). The College of Engineering PhD sets its own fee, GRE and English rules (see the engineering program overrides). The full International Applicant policy page (www1.villanova.edu .../applying-to-villanova/international.html) and the villanova.edu graduate pages returned 502 and were not checked.
